item.title: Thousands of runners lace up for River City Half Marathon and 5K
item.description: Brian Flynn, of the town of Ashland in Hanover County, was the first to finish the River City Half Marathon, running at 01:10:20.

item.title: Man found dead in ditch in Prince Edward, sheriff's office investigating
item.description: The Prince Edward County Sheriff's Office is investigating after a man was found dead in a ditch Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Why are flags at half-staff in Virginia?
item.description: Flags outside government buildings across Virginia will be flown at half-staff on Saturday in honor of Reverend Jesse L. Jackson, Sr., who died on Feb. 17.

item.title: StormTracker8: A very nice Monday ahead
item.description: Monday will be a very nice day, under mostly sunny skies

item.title: 42nd Annual Craftsmen's Spring Classic Art & Craft Festival returns to Richmond
item.description: The 42nd Annual Craftsmen's Spring Classic Art & Craft Festival will return to Richmond this weekend, with pottery, fine art, glass and more.

item.title: Fans get sneak peek inside Richmond Flying Squirrels' new CarMax Park at Nutzy's Block Party
item.description: For the first time, the Richmond Flying Squirrels welcomed fans inside CarMax Park off Arthur Ashe Boulevard ahead of the ballpark's first season next month.

item.title: Virginia Museum of History and Culture unveiled new exhibit on foreign allies
item.description: The Virginia Museum of History and Culture has opened a new exhibit for a limited time on foreign allies who helped America gain Independence.

item.title: 3 Henrico men charged after Shockoe Bottom shooting killed 2, injured 7
item.description: Richmond authorities are providing more updates after two people were arrested Saturday in connection with a deadly Shockoe Bottom shooting last month.

item.title: 'We honor his service and sacrifice': Soldier with Virginia ties killed during operation in Kuwait
item.description: A man with ties to Spotsylvania County was killed after an Iranian strike in Kuwait, according to Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) and U.S. Senators Mark Warner and Tim Kaine (Both D-Va.).

item.title: Virginia bill aims to provide free breakfast for all public school students
item.description: Advocates are working to pass a bill in the General Assembly that would provide free breakfast for all Virginia public school students, as 43% of students are not guaranteed one at their schools.
